name: Ansible
description: Ansible automation control node with ansible-core and the community collection bundle, installed in an isolated uv environment.

notes.text: Command-line control node; use the container console. No web interface or application daemon.
Inventory is /etc/ansible/hosts. Store playbooks and custom roles or collections in /opt/ansible-data.
Updates install the latest compatible stable Ansible package from PyPI. Review Ansible porting guides before upgrading.
Proxmox installation and arm64 support have not yet been tested.
